Name: Abandoned Power Plant
Description1: An abandoned man-made power plant. The place is full of decrepit structures and high chances of electric shocks!
Description2: Explorers will find many Electric/Poison/Steel-type Pokemon here.

PossibleWeathers.Name: None
PossibleWeathers.Description: No particular weather in this dungeon.

PossibleWeathers.Name: Flooded
PossibleWeathers.Description: The Power Plant is partly flooded this week. Expect water all over the floor.

PossibleWeathers.Name: High Voltage Arcs
PossibleWeathers.Description: There's a constant discharge of electricty around the Plant that may hit Pokemon.

PossibleWeathers.Name: Ion Deluge
PossibleWeathers.Description: The air is Ionized and smells funny. All Normal-type attacks become Electric-type.

EncounterPool.PreEncounterString: In the recycle bin, you see a perfectly functional $1 inside.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: You pick it up and continue on your way.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: You have no space remaining for it, you leave it in the trash.

EncounterPool.Note: Just a mon from next floor but has an item equipped which it'll use during the fight
EncounterPool.PreEventString: In the middle of a room, you find a $2, but it's being guarded by a $1.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: $1 runs away, you have taken its $2.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: It seems the $2 will remain safe here for now...

EncounterPool.PreEventString: Inside of a glass panel, a purple evolution crystal is connected to a number of cables. It whispers: YE WHO SEEK AWAKENING, LET US BEGIN.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: The evolution crystal lost most of its power, will take  abit before it can recharge.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: There's nothing here for you. The evolution crystal doesn't react anymore.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old first-aid kit.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: Your Pokemon have recovered some health.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: None of your Pokemon are injured, you leve it there just in case anyone else needs it.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old first-aid kit, but it only has enough medicine for a single Pokemon.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: You decide to apply it to $1, which is now fully recovered.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: None of your Pokemon are injured, you leve it there just in case anyone else needs it.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You reach a room with a lot of electrified cables hanging.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: A pair of cables shocks $1, who suddenly springs back to life!

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old first-aid kit.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: Your Pokemon have recovered from their status conditions.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: None of your Pokemon are injured, you leve it there just in case anyone else needs it.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: A young $1 appears in front of you and starts flexing. It's showing off!
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: It decides to follow you, show you what it's made of.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You walk on top of a decrepit catwalk.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: It obviously was a terrible idea! You and your Pokemon have sustained a bit of damage.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You arrive to an area that is partly flooded.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: Unfortunately, a live wire is touching the water! $1 is electrocuted and is now paralyzed!

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You reach a room with a lot of electrified cables hanging.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: A pair of cables shocks $1, who gets immediately vaporized

EncounterPool.PreEventString: $1 is in the Abandoned Plant, as lost as you are. 'The only thing to do now is to battle!', they say
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: $1 goes home defeated. You continue onwards.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: This victory leaves $1 energized. They start running onwards at maximum speed. You're unable to catch on.

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old Automatic ATM machine on a wall.
You find some Team Paradox members carrying a crate full of blank disks. You are extremely suspicious of them.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: They give you $1 as a bribe to look away.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: They take a quick look at you, and they continue on their way. 'Nothing to see here!

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find an old lunch table. The perfect place for a picnic.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: If you had a sandwich, you could take a lunch break in here...

EncounterPool.PreEventString: You find Arven in a mess hall, he's just making some sandwiches.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: He shares a $1 with you, so you can try it next time you have a chance.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: Arven is such a beginner! A real explorer always has a whole bag full of Sandwiches, gotta go!

EncounterPool.Note: Homage to the magnemite vs grimer episode
EncounterPool.PreEventString: Suddenly. you're caught in the crossfire in a war for territory between two species of Pokemon that reside in the power plant.
EncounterPool.EncounterSuccessString: After the dust settles, both sides retreat to their own territories.
EncounterPool.EncounterFailureString: You should've been wiser than to get caught into a fight between wild Pokemon!

FinalBossEncounter.PreEncounterString: You reach the power plant's generator. The energy in this room is out of control. In the center, absorbing most of the energy a titan made of pure electricity. Before you can react, it starts moving all over the place...
FinalBossEncounter.EncounterSuccessString: As you defeat the titan, the whole power plant starts to make a deafening noise. Parts start moving and the Power Plant starts sparking. Better leave ASAP.
FinalBossEncounter.EncounterFailureString: The energies in this place are running out of control. It is no longer safe to remain here.
FinalBossEncounter.Note: Regieleki with with either/and Deluge + Arcs. Make regieleki faster and fight a bit longer. Regieleki will be by itself

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have disturbed a nest belonging to a mother $1. She'll do the best to defend it's babies.
BossEncounters.EncounterSuccessString: $1 has calmed down and is now hiding with their babies. You proceed forward.
BossEncounters.EncounterFailureString: Momma $1 is out of control. If you approach her or any of her children, things are going to go south very fast!
BossEncounters.Note: The idea of this one is a mon of current floor, slightly stronger (15% except speed) equipped, with 2 babies (weaker)

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have arrived to a huge room. An enormous $1 is in the middle, suffering. It seems the great energies of this place have overloaded it and it's out of control.
BossEncounters.EncounterSuccessString: $1 releases all of it's energy and recovers. It's extremely thankful.
BossEncounters.EncounterFailureString: The energies that $1 absorbed are too much. It's terrible to leave this creature suffering, but there's nothing else you can do...
BossEncounters.Note: Inspired on deepest trench mutant mon. This mon is huge, resistant and slow, it's a survival fight. Will be in high voltage always, open field and try to add the 'giant' tag for impact

WeatherOverride.Name: High Voltage Arcs
WeatherOverride.Description: There's a constant discharge of electricty around the Plant that may hit Pokemon.

BossEncounters.PreEncounterString: You have crossed eyes with an angry $1. Apparently it's the boss of this floor, and you're in their territory!.
BossEncounters.EncounterSuccessString: $1 runs away scared, it seems you're the Power Plant Boss now.
BossEncounters.EncounterFailureString: Now you see why $1 is the boss around these parts. Better leave before you make it angrier...
BossEncounters.Note: Monster house inspired, there's a big boss from next floor with buddies from first floor, and the buddies keep coming
